_comment: Which agents the bus can run, and how to invoke each one.
THE HUB CAN ONLY RUN WHAT IS LISTED HERE. The web form picks an id from this
file; it never sends a command. That is deliberate — a form that could pass a
shell string to a worker on your machine is a remote-code-execution hole with a
text box in front of it, even on loopback. Adding a runner is editing this file.
type 'ollama' — POSTed to /api/generate. Nothing to install beyond the model.
dialect LM Studio, llama.cpp server, vLLM and text-generation-webui all speak.
baseUrl is LOOPBACK-ONLY — a runner entry is the boundary of what a task can
reach, and that boundary is this machine. Run `server.mjs discover` to find
these servers and print ready-to-paste (disabled) draft entries.
type 'shell'  — spawned with the prompt written to STDIN. args are passed as a
list, never joined into a string, so nothing in a prompt can be read as an
GLM turned out NOT to need a shell runner. `ollama launch claude` presents a
model menu, and GLM 5.3 Flash in that menu is an ollama CLOUD model — so it
answers /api/generate like any local one, under the name glm-5.3-flash:cloud.
It is not in `ollama list` because nothing was pulled.
The shell type stays for a genuine command-line agent, if one is ever added.

runners.label: gpt-oss:20b — local
runners.note: The project's default local model. A THINKING model despite the name: ollama returns its reasoning in `thinking` and the answer in `response`. It was flagged false here and three build tasks in a row came back as stranded reasoning, because 1200 output tokens is not enough to think AND answer. MEASURED 2026-09-09 on a real spec at num_ctx 32768: done_reason stop, 7,534 tokens of a 14,000 budget, weights fully resident (/api/ps size_vram == size) — so the window is paid for.

runners.label: qwen2.5-coder:14b — local
runners.note: Code-weighted. Drafts schemas confidently and gets types wrong; review closely.

runners.label: codestral:22b — local
runners.note: BENCHED OUT 2026-09-12: 5.0/10 vs winner 8.3, and only 1.5x the winner's speed — the bench's only delete suggestion, and you ran the rm yourself. The entry stays as the routing record's verdict; re-pull the model and flip enabled back to true to bring it back.

runners.label: qwen2.5:7b — local, fast
runners.note: Fast and shallow. Good for extraction and summarising, not design.

runners.label: GLM 5.3 Flash — cloud
runners.note: Served by ollama as a CLOUD model, so it is not in `ollama list` and needs no pull. A THINKING model: it spends output tokens reasoning before it answers, so num_predict has to be generous or `response` comes back empty with the reasoning stranded in `thinking`. MEASURED 2026-09-09 on the compaction-baseline spec: the 32,000 budget ran out FIRST (eval_count == num_predict) and the 32,768 window was only 88 tokens behind it, so both were doubled; at 64000/65536 the same spec completed — done_reason stop, 35,090 tokens used (125,803 chars of thinking), 29k of budget spare. Cloud-side, so a bigger window costs no VRAM. judge:true — the bench's reference baseline and grader; it is benched too, but never ranked against the local candidates. CLOUD: a task sent here sends its prompt off-machine.
